history.summary: An Allgreen freehold (2015) in West Coast D05 with a strong 722 score and a large 1,259 sqft 2BR asking only $1,493 PSF — a 16% discount to the $1,782 median. The catch: at 1,259 sqft this is an oversized 2BR (low efficiency) whose cheap PSF partly reflects size, and appreciation is a soft 1.28%/yr.
history.rating_rationale: score_1000 722 (top of batch) and on_frontier=true flag good value, and $1,493 vs $1,782 median is -16%. But 1,259 sqft for a 2BR is unusually large — the low PSF is partly a size artefact, and the $1.88M absolute price for a 2BR is high. Allgreen is an established developer with ~95% profitable resales reported, supporting downside protection. Appreciation of 1.28%/yr on 26 txns is weak. Net: solid quality and value, capped growth — a balanced Neutral.

history.summary: Freehold 2015 DUPLEX PENTHOUSE (2-bed + study + bomb shelter, corner) in D05 West Coast by Allgreen. The algo's -18.1% age-adj cheapness and -15.1% cohort discount are largely the structural PSF discount that penthouses/duplexes carry, not a clean district bargain.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1.88M at $1,493 psf for a 1,259 sqft freehold duplex penthouse. Web-verified: this is a 2-bed+study corner duplex (the bedroom_sqft_mismatch flag = duplex layout, not a data error). Project 12-month transactions average ~$1,702 psf (range $1,306-$1,864), so the asking sits ~12% below the project pool - but penthouse/duplex stock structurally trades at a lower PSF than stacked typical units, so this is the expected large-format discount rather than evidence of underpricing. The -15.1% psf_premium_vs_cohort rests on just 3 cohort txns - thin and unreliable. D05 is RCR-ish/OCR-fringe with reasonable ~+3.5% realized forward, Allgreen is a credible developer, and West Coast benefits from the broader Greater Southern Waterfront / one-north spillover narrative. Quality FH penthouse but at a $1.88M quantum with the usual penthouse liquidity/holding-cost drag - a fair-value hold, not an obvious value buy.
red_flags: psf_premium_vs_cohort (-15.1%) rests on only 3 cohort transactions - statistically thin
Duplex penthouse = lower liquidity and longer time-to-sell on a 5-7yr exit
Low 5yr URA CAGR (+1.28%) - muted recent capital performance
$1.88M quantum is high for a 2-bedroom configuration
